adjudication.rationale: In handleNewBooking.ts, `teamMemberPromises` is built via `users.slice(1).map(async (user) => { ... teamDestinationCalendars.push(user.destinationCalendar); ... await getTranslation(...) })`. This mutates `teamDestinationCalendars` as a side effect while constructing attendee/team-member objects, coupling two concerns in one pass. While it likely works (the `push` occurs before the first `await` in the async callback), the design is brittle/implicit and would be clearer/safer as a separate explicit collection step over `users`.
